deadline_policy: One 900 s deadline begins before input authentication. Metadata/download commands and both original native parsers use timeout=min(original120,remaining); native children use min(their original cap,remaining); ZIP and file inventories check remaining per payload. Original bounded owned-group cancellation/final display cleanup leave main under 1050 s, with 20 min native job. No stage resets the deadline. All xcodebuild stages, including version/settings/build/native, observe and clean the owned process group after reaping within the 1050 s hard deadline. Unobserved or live group state aborts collection; an unverified terminal writer prevents sealing/upload.
